stack.title: Local stack
stack.lead: Start Orazaka on this Mac with the orazaka CLI, then open the workspace.
stack.noServices: Status not read yet — press Refresh.
stack.logsEmpty: Nothing yet. Start the stack, run doctor or fetch the service logs.
stack.sidecarMissing: The orazaka CLI is missing from this build.
stack.needsNode: The CLI needs Node.js 22 or later on this Mac (brew install node).
stack.workspaceNeeded: Choose the Orazaka workspace folder in Settings so the CLI knows where the stack lives.
stack.remoteNote: You are connected to {host}. The local stack is optional here — start it only to run Orazaka on this Mac.

files.title: Files Orazaka can read
files.lead: Orazaka can read only the folders listed here — nothing else on this Mac. You choose them, and you can take them back at any time.
files.none: No folder yet. Orazaka cannot read any file on this Mac.
files.truncated: Only the first entries are shown.
files.select: Select a file to preview it.
files.send: Send to the open workspace page
files.sendHint: Puts the file in the first file field of the workspace page (a Studio input, the knowledge base). Open the workspace and the right Studio first.
files.binary: No preview for this kind of file.
files.dropLead: A dropped file can be previewed and sent for this session only. A dropped folder is shared only if you confirm.
files.newFilesNone: Nothing new yet. Turn on “Watch for new files” on a folder.
files.forbidden: This folder cannot be shared (too broad or sensitive).

settings.title: Settings
settings.remoteHelp: https only. You sign in on the Orazaka page itself — this app never stores a password.
settings.workspaceHelp: Where orazaka.workspace.json lives. The CLI runs there; the app does not read it.
settings.startup: Start Orazaka when I log in
settings.startupHelp: Off by default. Runs in the menu bar; nothing is started unless you ask.
settings.about: Orazaka Desktop is unsigned for now: if macOS refuses to open it, right-click the app and choose Open.

automations.title: Automations
automations.lead: Work Orazaka does on its own, on this Mac, with your local model. It reads only the folder you choose and asks you before it writes anything.
automations.killSwitchOn: All agents are stopped on this Mac
automations.killSwitchOnLead: No automation runs and every schedule is paused until you resume.
automations.templateSummariseLead: Every morning, reads the PDFs that arrived in a folder and saves a short summary note next to each one.
automations.noneLead: Start from a template: Orazaka will ask you before it writes the first file.

form.name: Name
form.folderHint: Only a folder you shared in Files. Orazaka reads it and writes the notes next to the PDFs — nowhere else.
form.noFolder: Share a folder in Files first.
form.modelHint: A model served on this Mac (Ollama, LocalAI, mlx_lm.server) — nothing leaves the Mac.
form.dryRunHint: Shows what it would write, writes nothing.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.lead: Orazaka wants to write these files. Nothing is written until you decide.
approvals.alwaysHint: Creates a permission for this automation, this tool and this folder only. You can take it back below.

grants.title: Permissions you gave
grants.none: No permanent permission. Every write asks first.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Everything automations did on this Mac, in order. Each entry is chained to the previous one: an edited or deleted line is detected.
